557:t_111:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then what'll you do if something happens in that world that you don't like?!」

557:t_111:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「Don't think someone who keeps whining about the past can do anything!」

557:t_111:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'll drill through your rotten spirit and your plan!!」

557:t_112:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'll teach you something! People have a present because they have a past, and that's how they can move on to the future!」

557:t_112:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm not interested in a cliched sermon. All I'm doing is correcting a mistake.」

557:t_112:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then I'm the same! I'll end your mistaken plan right here!」

557:t_112:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Taking the lives of people all over the world to heal your own sorrow can't possibly be right!」

557:t_113:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Enough of your selfish logic! If you don't like this world, then you're the one who should leave!」

557:t_113:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's not that simple. I want to live too.」

557:t_113:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then how can you stand by while everyone else's lives are lost?!」

557:t_113:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「In the end, what you're trying to do is nothing but selfishness!!」

557:t_114:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Stop your pointless resistance right now and surrender!」

557:t_114:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Stop your pointless resistance right now and surrender!」

557:t_114:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Stop your pointless resistance right now and surrender!」

557:t_114:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Sorry, but I have no intention of listening to an android.」

557:t_114:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ isn't human, but $$ノノ$$ is alive! And $$ノノ$$ won't stand by while someone's life is taken for somebody's selfish reasons!」

557:t_114:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ isn't human, but $$ノノ$$ is alive! And $$ノノ$$ won't stand by while someone's life is taken for somebody's selfish reasons!」

557:t_114:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ isn't human, but $$ノノ$$ is alive! And $$ノノ$$ won't stand by while someone's life is taken for somebody's selfish reasons!」

557:t_114:10.en:
$$レナード$$
「Because you're allies of justice...?」

557:t_114:11.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No, that's not it! Protecting someone's life is only natural for those who live in the same world!」

557:t_114:12.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「No, that's not it! Protecting someone's life is only natural for those who live in the same world!」

557:t_114:13.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「No, that's not it! Protecting someone's life is only natural for those who live in the same world!」

557:t_115:0.en:
$$葵$$
「You had it hard too, didn't you.」

557:t_115:2.en:
$$葵$$
「If you thought I'd say that, you're totally wrong. I have no intention of understanding a coward who thinks he's the only one who's hurting.」

557:t_115:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Well, aren't you blunt. As expected of an heir to the blood of beasts ruled by primal instinct.」

557:t_115:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「As I thought, a beast can only be subdued by force.」

557:t_115:5.en:
$$葵$$
「I like that side of you better than the smooth-talking pretty boy from before.」

557:t_115:6.en:
$$葵$$
「Then I won't hold back! I'll crush your plan right here!」

557:t_116:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「Now that the boss has shown himself, it's ours to win! All that's left is to stop you and end this plan!」

557:t_116:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Typical salaryman. That petty mentality of wanting the status quo is disgusting.」

557:t_116:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't lump people into some little box on your own! Unlike you, I just cherish life!」

557:t_116:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「$$ウィスパード$$ or genius, I don't care! I won't let a guy who takes the lives of people doing their best with his selfish logic do whatever he wants with the world!」

557:t_116:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do this! Learn the true strength of the salaryman you looked down on!」

557:t_117:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's a pity. With more time, I could have debated the meaning of the past and the future with you.」

557:t_117:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「I agree with that. It would have been a fruitful time.」

557:t_117:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even this short exchange made it clear to me. You have not the slightest intention of listening to other people.」

557:t_117:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I would never guess it from your elegant manner, but you are no different from the vulgar villains I despise. You are just as self-absorbed as they are.」

557:t_117:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「I understand too. Even if I debated with you, I'm sure I'd have gained nothing.」

557:t_117:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then, much as I dislike it, I will stop you by force here.」

557:t_117:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「For the sake of this ugly yet lovable world...!」

557:t_118:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「So even you, beings who can change the laws of the world, deny what I'm doing?」

557:t_118:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Of course we do! How can we keep quiet while countless lives are lost?!」

557:t_118:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「As expected of someone who made himself a human sacrifice for the world. I can't understand that spirit of self-sacrifice.」

557:t_118:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I don't need you to understand it! All I'm going to do is knock you flat and protect the lives living in this world!」

557:t_119:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Don't you get it?! There are people living their lives with all they've got in this world!」

557:t_119:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「They can live in the new world we create too.」

557:t_119:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「There's nothing new about that! It's a world where you rewrote the past however you liked!」

557:t_119:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I won't accept it! I'm not handing the history that $$ミコノ$$ and I have lived through over to the likes of you!」

557:t_120:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I know about you, $$碇シンジ$$. That you live in regret and wish to redo the world.」

557:t_120:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's not too late even now. If you come to me with that spear, I'll help you make amends too.」

557:t_120:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...But that would... take the lives of the people living in this world now...」

557:t_120:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll take responsibility for that. You don't need to trouble yourself over it.」

557:t_120:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...I can't... do something like that...」

557:t_120:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「Then you choose to live in regret? Without making any amends for the lives you took?」

557:t_120:7.en:
$$シンジ$$
「But...! I can't believe your way is right...!」

557:t_120:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll look for my own way...! And stop you, right here...!」

557:t_121:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I know about you too, $$ガロード・ラン$$.」

557:t_121:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Guess I've become famous! Even a villain knows my name!」

557:t_121:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「If you come to me with that $$ガンダム$$, I could prepare a world where you and $$ティファ・アディール$$ live happily.」

557:t_121:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Of course, with that power of hers never having existed.」

557:t_121:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「...You don't understand a thing about $$ティファ$$!」

557:t_121:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's true that the $$ニュータイプ$$ power has made $$ティファ$$ suffer...!」

557:t_121:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But now $$ティファ$$ is accepting that power and trying to move on to the future! I won't fall for the smooth talk of someone who doesn't get that!」

557:t_122:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Stop the plan right now! Do you understand what will come of what you're doing?!」

557:t_122:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Of course. But there is no reason to grieve over it.」

557:t_122:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「In the new world everyone can live smiling, and in this world the Empire will be wiped out as well.」

557:t_122:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「We aren't fighting only to defeat the Empire! We want to protect the people living in this world!」

557:t_122:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Someone who doesn't understand that has no right to move the world!」

557:t_123:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$アムロ・レイ$$... I know you are also tormented by wounds of the past.」

557:t_123:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But what I gained from them made me stronger, and became the strength to go beyond.」

557:t_123:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「You think this world has a future?」

557:t_123:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To find that out, too, I can't let you end the world here...!」
